cultural.vision_reason: This is a carved wooden mask combining crocodile, antelope, and bird features with painted decoration—a composite zoomorphic ritual mask consistent with Baga ceremonial mask traditions from coastal Guinea.

physical.title: mask
physical.summary: Mask; carved from wood; in the form of composite animal; long, pointed crocodile snout carved at front painted pink, metal jagged teeth painted white nailed to sides; human eyes (black pupils, white eyes) and nose carved on top of snout; small cow horns painted pink and pointed ears painted white on sides of head; head carved with lines; elaborately-carved ridge across top of head from front to back, painted pink with gold accents (bird?); knob (painted pink) with arch (painted with white and gold stripes) coming out of back of head; long twisted antelope horns painted black with white tips out back of head; strip of textile sewn along bottom of snout; holes carved along bottom of mask, through which would be threaded grass to cover body of dancer.
